text:
acme_prod_owner: Hey team, quick flag — after the rollout this morning our support agent responses are noticeably shorter and a bit more 'direct'. Not a total regression but customers are flagging it as less helpful. Example below.

emily_support: Thanks for reporting. Can you paste the pair (pre/post) responses and the request id or api call you used? We'll triage. :eyes:

acme_prod_owner: Yep — one quick repro. Prompt: "How do I reset my password?"
Old (from v8.2, timestamped yesterday): "You can reset your password by going to Settings > Account > Reset password. Follow the link we email you and choose a new password. If you don't receive the email, check spam or contact support and we'll help. Would you like me to send the reset link?"
New (after v8.3 push today): "Go to Settings > Reset password. Check email for link."

acme_prod_owner: We see this pattern across a handful of prompts — fewer clarifications, fewer offers to assist, and shorter sentences. Not tone-y in hostility, just stripped elaboration.

vikram_eng: Noted. Do you have the actual API request payload or request_id for a sample call? Also what model param did the call hit (model name/alias)?

acme_prod_owner: Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. We were using the default endpoint (no explicit model param). I attached a sanitized curl we used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{\"input\":\"How do I reset my password?\",\"max_tokens\":120,\"temperature\":0.2}'
```

natalie_research: deploy-bot shows a canary->full rollout at 2024-06-01T08:00 for model alias "prod-open-2" to backend image openmodel-v8.3. Release notes mention "response_compaction: enabled by default" — that could be it. @vikram_eng can you check rollout config?

deploy-bot: Deployment event: release id rel_20240601_0810, target alias prod-open-2, image openmodel-v8.3, flags: {response_compaction:true, default_max_output_tokens:120}. Canary started 08:00, full rollout 08:18.

vikram_eng: Thanks — that flag was intended for internal evaluation only. Looks like the rollout spec accidentally included it. If true this would systematically bias the decoding towards shorter outputs.

andre_ops: :grimacing: Was that flag part of the DB config update? I see a PR landed that toggled default flags for production images.

vikram_eng: I can replicate locally by hitting the new image. Quick experiment: make same request with explicit model param to old vs new image. Run these two commands and compare "choices[0].tokens" length: 
```
# old image
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"openmodel-v8.2\",\"input\":\"How do I reset my password?\",\"max_tokens\":120,\"temperature\":0.2}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
# new image
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"model\":\"openmodel-v8.3\",\"input\":\"How do I reset my password?\",\"max_tokens\":120,\"temperature\":0.2}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
```

natalie_research: Also run a simple length batch to compare averages across a set of 50 prompts. Quick helper: 
```
cat prompts.txt | xargs -I {} -n1 curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"openmodel-v8.3\",\"input\":\"{}\",\"max_tokens\":120}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text' | wc -w
```
We should compare mean tokens and % of completions under N tokens.

emily_support: For immediate mitigation, we can route calls for this customer to the alias pinned to the previous model while eng investigates. Acme, would you like us to switch you back to the pinned alias for a few days?

acme_prod_owner: That would be great if possible. Impact: higher CS contacts and a few churn-risk customers. Appreciate quick turnaround.

vikram_eng: I'll open a rollback/patch ticket. Short-term plan: 1) revert response_compaction flag for prod images, 2) re-run regression tests and A/B on a small traffic slice, 3) if green, push fix. If we can't revert instantly we'll provide alias routing to v8.2 for impacted orgs.

andre_ops: Ticket created: INF-4921 "unintended response_compaction=true in v8.3 rollout". Assigned to @vikram_eng.

natalie_research: For signal, capture a set of customer prompts + previous reference replies and compute simple metrics: token length, conditional info density (presence of follow-ups/offers), and a short annotator sample for perceived helpfulness (3 judges). I'll stand up the quick eval harness.

emily_support: I'll notify the account team and update the support ticket with the pinned alias route. Also will ask the customer to share a handful more examples. :white_check_mark:

acme_prod_owner: Thanks all. Running the curl tests now and will paste outputs. Appreciate the fast response.

vikram_eng: FYI — if anyone needs to re-run the exact request we saw earlier, the debug trace id is debug_req_0a1b2c3d. It contains headers, prompt, and the model selected.

emily_support: Adding a note to the customer's record and flagging priority-high. Follow-up once rollback or alias routing is in place.

acme_prod_owner: Received. I'll be on standby.

(threads end)
